notes: The UAE legal jobs market on Indeed is heavily skewed toward: (1) Senior/Partner-level roles; (2) Arabic-speaking requirements; (3) UAE-qualified/registered lawyers; (4) 5+ years UAE-specific experience. For a candidate at Tanya's level (2+ years India PQE, no UAE admission, no Arabic) the qualifying pool is narrow. Only 2 roles of 56 scanned met all criteria. Next run (2026-06-24) should additionally search: 'Legal trainee', 'Legal assistant law firm', 'IP compliance associate'. Consider also Sharjah/Ajman searches if Dubai yields continue to be limited.
